boundary: Stage 27N is bounded cross-scale evidence for calibrated output-side eraser-cover intervention over Pythia-1B CPL2 likelihood margins. It is not cross-architecture evidence, not weight editing, not complete circuit discovery, not model-wide control, and not visible free-form generation control.

random_control_match_profile.policy: Random controls use same layer/kind replacements when available. For singleton MLP blocks, the fallback preserves kind across candidate layers; if that is impossible, the report marks an unmatched fallback.
